property_summary: After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the BASE_RESERVE_ stays unchanged (equal to its pre-call value) because only _MT_FEE_RATE_ is modified.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ stays unchanged (equal to its pre-call value) because only _MT_FEE_RATE_ is modified.
After adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged (equal to its value before the call).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ public getter remains unchanged (equal to its value before the call).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ should remain unchanged (equal to its pre-call value) because _setReserve is not involved.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ should remain unchanged (equal to its previous value) because adjustMtFeeRate only modifies _MT_FEE_RATE_.

After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ should be equal to the balance of _BASE_TOKEN_ held by the contract minus _MT_FEE_BASE_ (capped to uint112 max), regardless of the fee rate parameter.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid mtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged (equal to its value before the call).
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ stored in storage must equal the contract's base token balance minus _MT_FEE_BASE_, capped to uint112 max.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ must equal the contract's BASE_TOKEN balance minus _MT_FEE_BASE_, capped to uint112 max.

After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ should equal the actual base token balance of the contract (minus mt fee base), reflecting a sync that updates both reserves when either changes.
After adjusting the mt fee rate, the reported base reserve must reflect the actual base token balance (minus mt fee base) when the quote reserve has also been updated.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the actual base token balance (minus MT_FEE_BASE) minus _BASE_RESERVE_ must equal the return value of getBaseInput().
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, getBaseInput() returns 0, because the contract's base token balance minus base reserve and mt fee base is zero.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the actual base token balance of the contract minus _MT_FEE_BASE_ must equal _BASE_RESERVE_, because _sync() should update _BASE_RESERVE_ to match the current balance.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ equals the quoteReserve parameter passed to _setReserve during the call.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the public getter for _QUOTE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged (equal to its value before the call).
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve remains the same as before the call.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _QUOTE_RESERVE_ equals the value of _QUOTE_RESERVE_ before the call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve cannot be zero because the bug sets it to zero.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve remains unchanged from its value before the call.

After any call sequence ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve _QUOTE_RESERVE_ equals the quote token balance minus the quote fee, reflecting the fact that _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should track the actual quote token reserve.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate(uint256), the internal _QUOTE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged because adjustMtFeeRate only modifies _MT_FEE_RATE_ and does not alter reserves.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the difference between the quote token balance (minus accumulated MtFee) and the quote reserve _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should remain unchanged (i.e., the net quote input stays constant).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should equal the quote token balance of the contract minus the accumulated mtFee quote.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve stored in _QUOTE_RESERVE_ must equal the actual quote token balance of the contract minus the accumulated mtFeeQuote.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve must not exceed the contract's quote token balance minus accumulated mtFeeQuote.
After adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve is bounded by the actual quote balance minus accumulated mtFeeQuote.
After adjustMtFeeRate, the sum of _QUOTE_RESERVE_ and _MT_FEE_QUOTE_ equals the contract's quote token balance.
After adjusting mtFeeRate, the quote reserve is derived from the actual quote balance minus accumulated mtFeeQuote, using the same formula as the base reserve.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_TARGET_ should remain between 0 and the current base reserve (inclusive).
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_TARGET_ should be less than or equal to the _BASE_RESERVE_ when _RState_ is BELOW_ONE.

After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the sum of _BASE_TARGET_ and (totalSupply == 0 ? 0 : 1001) should equal the initial _BASE_TARGET_ set in the first buyShares when totalSupply was 0 plus any subsequent increases via buyShares.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the sum of _BASE_TARGET_ and _SHARES_ (balanceOf) of address(this) times the ratio of _BASE_TARGET_ to totalSupply should remain unchanged when totalSupply > 0.

After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_TARGET_ should equal the initial shares minted to address(0) (which is burnt) times the ratio of totalSupply to (totalSupply + 1001) when the first buyShares had totalSupply == 0.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid fee rate, the _QUOTE_TARGET_ remains unchanged.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid fee rate, the _QUOTE_TARGET_ remains unchanged.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid fee rate, the _QUOTE_TARGET_ remains unchanged.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid fee rate, the _QUOTE_TARGET_ remains unchanged.
After calling correctRState(), the quote target is never less than the quote reserve when RState is above one.
The value of _QUOTE_TARGET_ after adjustMtFeeRate does NOT depend on the new fee rate when the R state is not BELOW_ONE or base reserve is strictly less than base target.
When correctRState is called after adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_TARGET_ never increases above a previous query if the R state is BELOW_ONE and base reserve is <= base target.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _QUOTE_TARGET_ in the reference C never changes when the R state is BELOW_ONE and _BASE_RESERVE_ <= _BASE_TARGET_.
After adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_TARGET_ stays the same when correctRState is triggered with base reserve less than base target; in the mutant it changes when they are equal.

After adjustMtFeeRate, when the RState is BELOW_ONE and _BASE_RESERVE_ is exactly equal to _BASE_TARGET_, calling correctRState leaves _QUOTE_TARGET_ unchanged in the reference but changes it in the mutant.
The totalSupply after adjustMtFeeRate is unchanged from before the call.
After adjustMtFeeRate, the totalSupply equals the totalSupply before the call.
The totalSupply after adjustMtFeeRate remains equal to the totalSupply before the call, even when a prior sellShares call does not adjust totalSupply due to the bug.
After any number of calls, the totalSupply of the contract is always equal to the sum of all shares held by all addresses.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate that reverts, the totalSupply is unchanged.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, totalSupply remains unchanged from its value before the call.
totalSupply never decreases after any sequence of calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate
The totalSupply before and after any call to adjustMtFeeRate must be equal.
After any successful call to adjustMtFeeRate, the totalSupply equals the balance of shares of all holders plus the dead shares (1001) from the initial mint.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, totalSupply must be equal to the sum of balances of all share holders (including the zero address) that can be observed via balanceOf.
